answers.answer_text: Frontier region, border region — the area inside the border.

questions_and_answers.question_text: How does biānjiè differ from biānjiāng?

answers.answer_text: Biānjiè refers more specifically to the border or boundary itself.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which of the two words would you use for the borderland areas of a country?
Which of the two words would you use for a national boundary line?

answers.answer_text: Yes — it is a frontier region of China.

articles.text:
ADDITIONAL REQUIRED VOCABULARY

12. biānjiāng
   border area; borderland; frontier; frontier region

Note on Additional Required Vocabulary

biānjiāng: "frontier region, border region" This refers to the area inside the border. Biānjiè refers more specifically to the border or boundary itself.
